description: Two D_PDUs in the same modem block carry the same EOT, rounded up to the next half second, measured from the block's start to the planned end of the burst including the flush.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). Each S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is to SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 (the 648000-unit default, so TTD = request time + 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091), and asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095). The CAS wraps the DATA S_PDU (priority, SAP 5 to SAP 5, TTD) in a DATA C_PDU (B-0297). Each D_PDU is type 7 NON-ARQ-DATA (C-0323, C-0575) with EOW 0, EMPTY (C-0398), address size 3 (the smallest that holds both addresses, C-0133), source 0.0.1.2, the whole C_PDU as its one segment (offset 0, C_PDU size = segment size, C-0343, C-0346), DELIVER IN ORDER clear (C-0333), C_PDU IDs allocated from 0 in placement order (C-0326, C-1040), and no pre-fill (D-0003). The air start of a D_PDU is the start of the block holding its first byte, preamble_ms + block x block_ms (C-1043); EOT = ceil((duration_ms - air start) / 500) (C-0104, C-0891, D-0005, D-0017), and the reception window is the same value because every copy of the C_PDU is in this transmission (C-0350, C-0352). The waveform is drc.default_speed, wn 2 long (C-0894). U_PDUs "hello" then "world", equal priority, so oldest first (C-0853), C_PDU IDs 0 and 1. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 1, 256 bytes and 4500 ms a block. Both D_PDUs (35 bytes each) lie in block 0, so both start on air at 600 ms; duration 600 + 4500 + 1 = 5101 ms; 4501 ms is 9.002 half-second units, rounded up to 10 (C-0891). The flush counts as post-fill (D-0005, D-0017). Slotted position 1 with no transmission yet: zero contention wait. Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
